note: Display layers for the Bridge. Each block names its source file; absent layers are listed in 'missing'.

waves.encoding: uint8[leads][ny][nx], decimetres rounded up, 255 = no value (land, or under sea ice where the wave model writes NaN)
waves.reduction: 3x3 block max of VHM0_dmax (the daily max of 3-hourly significant wave height) onto the 0.25 deg ice grid
waves.day_max_note: full-resolution daily max over the box; the source gate uses it as the worst case for open-water cells with no wave value
waves.source: E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information (CMEMS); GLOBAL_ANALYSIS_FORECAST_WAV_001_027

wind.encoding: int8 U[leads][ny][nx] then int8 V[leads][ny][nx], units of 0.25 m/s (eastward, northward 10 m wind)
wind.reduction: every 2nd point of the native 0.25 deg IFS grid; one step per forecast day, nearest to 12 UTC (dakshin/real_world.py rule)
wind.licence: Contains modified ECMWF open data (CC BY 4.0), https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/datasets/open-data

depth.encoding: int16 little-endian [ny][nx]: elevation in metres of the SHALLOWEST point in each ~0.11 deg block (negative = below sea level); 32767 = mostly land or ice surface
depth.reduction: 2x2 block max of 'elevation' (itself the shallowest value per 0.05 deg cell)
depth.source: IBCSO v2 ice-surface elevation, Cape Town-Bharati corridor, ~0.05 deg
depth.citation: Dorschel, B., Hehemann, L., Viquerat, S., et al. (2022). The International Bathymetric Chart of the Southern Ocean Version 2. Scientific Data 9, 275, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01366-7. Dataset: PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.937574
depth.caveat: IBCSO is a scientific compilation, not an official electronic navigational chart (ENC). Not for navigation.

bergs.source: US National Ice Center Antarctic iceberg list (AntarcticIcebergs_20261120.csv)
bergs.uncertainty_provenance: dakshin/figures/berg_hindcast.json: uncertainty_radius_km_per_day (median drift-model error over the USNIC hindcast)
bergs.uncertainty_rule: radius_km = uncertainty_km_per_day x days between the position fix and the time shown; no circle for times before the fix
